title: 第13章 叶不凡卒第14章 新的天命主角
slug: 反派神子开局送主角九族消消乐
content_zh:
“有一天，平凡彻底惹恼了女孩…”
“女孩借助恶屠家族的力量，亲自带人屠灭了平凡的家族！”
“平凡从未认清自己的位置，故此招来大祸，其母用自己的生命为平凡挡下一劫…”
“后来，平凡终于发觉…”
“自己曾经是多么的愚蠢！”
“他终于明白，自己生命中最重要的，不是那个女孩！”
“而是…”
“那些一直陪在自己身旁，不曾离开的人！”
“如果说平凡的生命是一艘船，那么他的父母便是那条河流，每当船只搁浅，总是以自己的生命将它托举，送至远方…”
“平凡发誓，绝不再犯同样的错误！”
“他努力修炼，游走于各大道域…”
“无数年后，他成就大帝之上，终于站在了诸天顶端，屠灭了恶屠的家族，并亲手杀了他曾经那个爱得死去活来、现在已成人妇的女人…”
“后来，他跪在父母的坟前，像一个做错事的孩子，痛哭流涕…”
“在摇曳的光影里，背后早已空无一人，只余风声呜咽…”
故事结束，姜夜晃晃悠悠地随意甩弄着棒球棍，像是将要行刑的刽子手，神情淡漠而残酷。
叶不凡沉默着。
两行热泪无声滑落。
他知道姜夜是在暗示自己，如果今日云雅曼没死，迟早有一天会亲自前来处理掉他！
但冥冥之中。
叶不凡很是奇怪的感觉到，这段故事仿佛是他原本的人生轨迹…

这时，姜夜高高举起钢棍，俊美如妖的脸庞浮现一抹残忍的笑，语气如同冰霜：
“你可以呼吸。”
“你可以哭泣。”
“也可以在心中向上帝忏悔！”
“但是记住！
一定要虔诚！”
说完，手中钢棍狠狠落下！
没有哭声，只有四处迸溅的脑浆与鲜血。

content_en:
"One day, Ordinary completely annoyed the girl..."
"With the help of the evil slaughter family, the girl personally led people to slaughter the ordinary family!"
"Pingfan never recognized his position, so he caused great disaster. His mother used her own life to prevent Pingfan from disaster..."
"Later, Pingfan finally discovered..."
"How stupid I have been!"
"He finally understood that the most important thing in his life is not that girl!"
"But..."
"Those who are always by your side and never leave!"
"If ordinary life is a boat, then his parents are the river. Whenever the boat runs aground, they always use their own lives to lift it and send it to a distant place..."
"I swear I will never make the same mistake again!"
"He practiced hard and traveled around various realms..."
"Countless years later, he became a great emperor and finally stood at the top of the world. He slaughtered the evil Tu family and personally killed the woman he once loved so much that he was now an adult..."
"Later, he knelt in front of his parents' graves, crying like a child who had done something wrong..."
"In the swaying light and shadow, there is no one behind, only the sound of the wind is whimpering..."
At the end of the story, Jiang Ye was swinging his baseball bat casually, like an executioner about to be executed, with an expression of indifference and cruelty.
Ye Bufan was silent.
Two lines of hot tears fell silently.
He knew that Jiang Ye was hinting to him that if Yun Yaman hadn't died today, sooner or later he would come to deal with him in person!
But somewhere.
Ye Bufan felt strangely that this story seemed to be his original life trajectory...
At this time, Jiang Ye raised the steel rod high, a cruel smile appeared on his handsome and demonic face, and his tone was like frost:
"You can breathe."
"You can cry."
“You can also repent to God in your heart!”
"But remember!
Must be pious! "
After saying that, the steel rod in his hand fell hard!
There was no crying, just brains and blood splattering everywhere.
